title: Number Interface

fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: Generates a signal of arbitrary strength

body:
"Allows you to input large numbers directly, outputting that number as the signal value."

The Number Interface is a logic component that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics. It outputs a signal depending on what is entered into its interface.

Functionality

When placed, the Number Interface starts with a value of 1.0. Interacting with it allows the user to input any arbitrary positive whole number into the Number Interface. It will then output a signal of the same value on its output port. This allows the user to quickly generate large numbers for structures like the Electronic Billboard or 14 Segment Display, or to pack a decimal representation of a binary value for use with a Bit Out.
